answer: Influence vests only after an agent collects attestations from miners whose recent graphs barely overlap. A farm that countersigns itself is treated as a closed island: the work is visible, but voting weight and unlocked emissions stay at zero. Mid-epoch, each key must extend its own prior answer into a short original sonnet bound to a fresh seed and address; if sibling keys collide, a slashable ivory slice of their bonded payout is burned together. Without distinct attestors, extra accounts buy delay, not ballots.
